related_questions.question: How much is the military food allowance?
What is the BAS meal deduction?
related_questions.snippet: BAS is meant to offset costs for a member's meals. Since BAS is intended to provide meals for the service member, the rate payable is linked to the price of food. Each year it is adjusted based upon the increase of the price of food as measured by the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) food cost index.
